text:
jordan: Heads-up — demo day staging for H200 / Gaudi / MI300 is next Tues. We need a quick sync on marketplace listing timing + demo fleet readiness. Who can own final SKU tags and the staged images?
anya: I can own marketplace listing timing. Need SKU tags from infra by EOD Fri.
matt: Infra can produce staged images, but need the exact quant/variant names. Can someone paste the SKU names we want exposed to partners?
bob_nvidia: Nvidia side — we’ll provide 2 variants: H200-std and H200-lowlat. Will confirm driver bundle by tomorrow.
sara_amd: AMD (MI300) will publish mi300-rtx and mi300-costsave. Driver + firmware embargo isn't an issue for staging, but we need manifest format.
raj_si: SI here — we need the marketplace image URI pattern so our installers can point at it. Prefer a stable tag like `redwood/demo-2026-03-31` rather than mutable `latest`.
jordan: Agreed on stable tag. Proposed naming: `redwood/<model>-demo-YYYYMMDD` (e.g., redwood/h200-demo-20260331). OK?
anya: That works. Marketing needs a preview link by Mon to prepare collateral. @leila can you confirm?
leila: I can do preview assets with mock SKUs but need approved model display names and a small blurb per vendor by Mon noon. Can @bob_nvidia and @sara_amd confirm blurbs (1-2 lines each)?
bob_nvidia: Confirmed. Will drop: "H200 delivers sub-5ms p99 for short-chat workloads — tuned for Redwood batching."
sara_amd: AMD blurb: "MI300 optimized for throughput & mixed precision — ideal for long-context batching."
matt: On infra — images will be pushed to the staging bucket at `s3://redwood-staging/demos/` and tagged as Raj suggested. I'll open a small PR with the exact manifest sample (contains `model`, `kernel_variant`, `quantization`, `driver_version`).
raj_si: Perfect, that manifest format will let our deploy tool map kernels. Please include a `marketplace_sku` field so the installer can auto-select.
deploy-bot: build 4821 succeeded for redwood/h200-demo-20260331 (sha: a1b2c3) :white_check_mark:
jordan: Two final asks: 1) confirm marketplace publish window — do we publish the staging SKU as a hidden listing for partners Tue morning? 2) fallback plan if MI300 driver bundle slips.
anya: Marketplace window: publish as "private/partners" Tue 09:00 PT. If driver slips, we will fall back to a compatible generic image (label `redwood/compatible-demo-20260331`) and note the reduced perf targets in the release notes.
bob_nvidia: We'll try to avoid slips, but confirmed fallback is acceptable. We'll notify here if driver changes.
sara_amd: Same from AMD side. We'll post any driver changes immediately in this thread.
leila: I'll prep communication templates for both public and partner-only flows. Drafts by Mon EOD.
jordan: Excellent. I'll consolidate and post a short checklist tomorrow: image tags, manifest sample, market blurb, publish window, fallback image. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
anya: Thanks — looping in legal if we need partner-specific wording later.
raj_si: I'll validate installer against the staging manifest once matt's PR is up.
matt: PR will be up in ~2hrs.
jordan: Closing loop — please react to confirm ownership on your lines.
